name: SpaceFlow Technologies, Inc.
long_description:
SpaceFlow is the managed runtime for AI agents that execute supply chain work across ERPs, email, spreadsheets, documents, and supplier portals. It turns fragmented operational data and SOPs into a governed context layer, then gives agents reusable skills and controlled access to enterprise tools.

SpaceFlow agents normalize multi-round quotations, chase suppliers and delivery confirmations, repair incomplete requests, classify materials, reconcile phantom inventory, surface market signals, and help sales and operations planning teams continuously align demand, supply, inventory, purchasing deadlines, and freight decisions.

SpaceFlow deploys in the customer’s cloud or on-prem environment with permissions, human approvals, observability, and audit trails, allowing industrial and regulated enterprises to automate high-stakes operations without replacing existing systems or moving sensitive data.
one_liner: The managed runtime for enterprise AI agents
